Attack Vector: A threat actor took over an NPM account of one of the projects maintainers and then continued to publish multiple new versions of the package injected with malicious code that drains the wallets of users.
Indicators of Compromise: Discrepancy in package versions between the package manager (npm) and the version control system (Git). No changes and no tags or releases on the Ledger git corresponding to the malicious versions on the NPM package manager.
